description: Pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP batch production (MBR/eBMR), QMS (SOPs, QC CoA, OOS, Deviations/CAPA, Equipment Qualification, Stability/Retained Samples, Supplier Qualification, PQR), and GS1/EPCIS serialization pack — zero patient/EMR/HIS coupling.
intendedDeveloperAudience: Quality Assurance & QC Laboratory Engineering Teams
providedCapabilities: Master Batch Records (MBR), bill of materials, and electronic Batch Manufacturing Records (eBMR)
Raw material quarantine-to-release gating and line clearance verification
QC Lab testing, OOS hold blocks, and QA-signed Certificate of Analysis (CoA)
Deviations, CAPA effectiveness enforcement, Complaint-to-Recall escalation
Equipment IQ/OQ/PQ qualification & calibration-expiry production gate
Stability studies, retained samples, supplier qualification, and Product Quality Review (PQR)
GS1 GTIN/SGTIN/SSCC serialization, aggregation hierarchy, EPCIS events, and batch recall quarantine

relevantStandardsAndApplicability.standard: WHO GMP & EU GMP Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11
relevantStandardsAndApplicability.scope: Technical enablers: ALCOA+ audit trails, dual-person maker-checker e-signatures, OOS/calibration release gates (organizational CSV/PQ validation required)
Serialization commissioning, parent-child aggregation, and recall trace queries

knownLimitations: Software alone does not confer WHO GMP, EU GMP, or FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance; site IQ/OQ/PQ validation and QA governance are mandatory.
External national verification hubs (e.g., EMVS/DSCSA VRS) require certified B2B transport adapters.
